header.name: Nikolai Sachok
header.lead_1: I build and operate production LLM systems: multi-agent orchestration, RAG, evaluation, and guardrails. Physicist by training, then two decades building software and leading engineering teams — 500+ apps shipped, 10M+ downloads — now building AI systems hands-on.
header.lead_2: I started out writing C++ simulations for CERN's LHC experiments, spent more than 20 years building software and leading engineering teams, and in 2025 rebuilt my delivery operation around AI — running an LLM-orchestrated pipeline solo, from design through release. Most of the work is the verification and eval that keeps quality up at volume: generation isn't the bottleneck, verification is.

video.caption: Who I am — a 5-min intro. I walk through the three questions an AI-engineering screen usually opens with: ① 20 years in software, the last two on AI · ② my most recent public project, Strata-RAG (retrieval + evaluation) · ③ my strongest languages and stack.

writing.title: Enterprise RAG & Agents Handbook
writing.desc: A practical, first-principles handbook on production RAG and agentic systems, teaching the why and the failure modes rather than the features.
writing.meta: Since July 2026 · Three courses, several languages

writing.title: Eval-First RAG: Use Separate Scores to Triage Failures
writing.desc: One end-to-end score shows that answer quality moved, but not what moved it. Scoring retrieval and generation separately turns an unclear regression into a decision about where to look first.
writing.meta: September 3, 2026 · dev.to · also on Medium and LinkedIn

cards.title: Strata-RAG
cards.desc: An eval-first, study-grade RAG engine over heterogeneous corpora — Qdrant + HNSW, hybrid retrieval with RRF, cross-encoder re-ranking, a metadata sidecar for aggregation, and an eval harness (Recall@K / nDCG / MRR + LLM-judge faithfulness) with layered injection/PII defenses.

cards.title: strata-insurance-corpus
cards.desc: A reproducible, synthetic, multi-format insurance document corpus — born-digital and scanned PDFs, Word, spreadsheets, photos — with a golden evaluation set by construction. Built to benchmark document-RAG on enterprise-shaped data.

cards.title: DC-plugins
cards.desc: Native macOS plugins for Double Commander (Objective-C, universal binaries, headless tests, CI) — a small native tool taken end-to-end to a published standard.
